providers.plain_description: Blend each numeric value with the mean of its explicitly selected neighbors.
providers.validity_bounds: Nonempty finite real vector, aligned square boolean neighbor mask and Python scalar strength in [0,1], excluding bool. Rows select neighbors; self-selection allowed. Empty rows retain their original values. Fresh finite float64 vector, signed values allowed. Adjacency, units, clipping and domain meaning are caller policy. Directed or unequal-degree masks need not conserve the global sum. Dense quadratic mask memory; no large-scale qualification. Reject unrepresentable arithmetic.

providers.plain_description: Join available context and past targets while building separate features for each validation fold.
providers.validity_bounds: Prepared configuration from qualified prepare, revalidated. For each site, choose latest context within lookback at or before each feature time; take nearest sites within metric radius with deterministic coordinate tie-breaking. Strict-past target lags use only the corresponding fold training history. Eleven features: coordinates, seasonal sine/cosine, context mean/distance/age/presence, historical target mean/presence/count. Missing aggregates are zero with presence flags. Build final training and query features using full observed history. Context timestamps are treated as availability times; caller must ensure this is valid. Raw coordinates remain features; no unseen-location or spatial-holdout claim.

providers.plain_description: Apply the chosen clipping and neighbor smoothing rules and return predictions with validation summaries.
providers.validity_bounds: Unmodified Predicted state from qualified predict. Clip to nonnegative values, construct a boolean mask excluding self and selecting exact same-time queries within the explicit planar radius, and call generic neighborhood blending with configured strength. Return finite JSON predictions, training/query/validated/warmup row counts, fold/tree counts, feature count and forward-validation MSE. Query population affects smoothing. No conservation, map matching, named submission format, independent final accuracy or unseen-location accuracy guarantee.

providers.plain_description: Fit forward validation models, measure held-out errors, and refit a final model on all training rows.
providers.validity_bounds: Unmodified Featured state from qualified features. ExtraTreesRegressor with explicit seeded controls and n_jobs=1. Each expanding fold trains only its training targets; held-out predictions are clipped then blended only among same-time held-out neighbors using the generic numeric provider. Warmup block has no held-out predictions; report MSE on validated rows only. Final model refits all observed training rows. Query rows and labels do not train or select the model. Forward validation permits repeated locations and does not prove spatial independence. Trusted in-process arrays and estimators; forged or concurrent mutation excluded.
